questions.text: What JSON structure should the Gemini resume analysis use? The source names the categories (skills, education, projects, experience, internships, certifications, technologies) but no schema.
questions.reason: The backend validation, the stored shape and the review page all depend on the response schema. Without it the implementation would have to invent one.

questions.text: Are the candidate's corrections stored separately from the AI output, or does the corrected version replace the AI output?
options: Store separately (keep the AI output and the candidate's corrections)
Replace the AI output with the candidate's corrected version
questions.reason: This decides the data model and whether the original analysis can be shown or compared later.
questions.answer: Store separately (keep the AI output and the candidate's corrections)

questions.text: What message should the candidate see when Gemini is unavailable or returns an invalid or incomplete response?
questions.reason: The source requires an understandable error but gives no wording. A default message will be used if left empty.
questions.answer: We couldn't analyze your resume right now. Please try again in a few moments. Your uploaded resume is safe. If the problem continues, you can try uploading your resume again or contact support.
